action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that node-sqlite3 incorrectly handled the coercion of
objects passed as statement bindings. An attacker could possibly use this
issue to execute arbitrary code.
isummary:
node-sqlite3 could be made to run programs if it received specially crafted
input.

node-sqlite3.description: asynchronous, non-blocking SQLite3 bindings for Node.js

title: node-sqlite3 vulnerability
